articles.summary: New York, NY, June 13, 2024/PRNewswire – Lument Finance Trust, Inc. (NYSE: LFT) (“LFT” or the “Company”) announced the declaration of a cash dividend of $0.08 per share of common stock with respect to the second quarter of 2024, which represents a 14% increase over the first quarter of 2024 dividend of $0.07 per share.
